blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Catholic priest Fr. Warren Puno expressed disappointment and indignation over the government’s failure to respond adequately to the grievances of environmentalists and marginalized communities at the end of a week-long protest march from Atimonan, Quezon, to Manila on Monday. “Bakit sarado ang pintuan sa panaghoy ng mamamayan? Para kanino ba talaga ang pamahalaan?” (Why are the doors closed to the people’s cries? Who is the government really for?) Puno asked in Filipino on a Facebook post on Monday night. On Oct. 5, Puno and 34 environmental advocates began a 154-kilometer protest march, dubbed “Lakbay Panaghoy II – Kalikasan, […]...
